items.title: Anthropic lost $42B last year: 2 hot takes on its leaked IPO filing
items.summary: Anthropic's (ANTH.PVT) IPO filing prospectus was leaked to Reuters on Monday, detailing the private AI developer's annual losses and infrastructure commitments. Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi shares his hot takes on the leaked S-1 filing and the risk factors the company cites inside it.

items.title: A closer look at Anthropic's 2025 losses, Dan Ives discusses AI safety risks
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi takes on the biggest stories as the trading day kicks off, weighing in on Anthropic's (ANTH.PVT) leaked IPO prospectus and Advanced Micro Devices' (AMD) deal to acquire World Labs. Yorkville Ives partner and senior managing director Dan Ives sits down with Sozzi for a conversation about the latest developments and safety concerns emerging from the AI space.

items.title: Salesforce Stock Fell 8% in a Year. Here’s Where the Street’s Target Sits Now.
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSalesforce stock is down 8% over the past year, closing at $225 on September 29. The stock slid to a June trough near $150, then jumped after Q2 results on August 26: revenue of $11.

items.summary: Oracle regained momentum after last week's force majeure, with 25 new agentic AI applications, today, Sept. 29, 2026.

items.title: Has MSFT Stock Run Out Of Steam?
items.summary: Just see what has actually been driving Microsoft stock. Over three years, revenue growth and wider margins did the heavy lifting while the P/E multiple shrank, yet the rally of the past three months leaned more on a richer multiple than on the business itself. Now, after that run, Microsoft (MSFT)’s stock has paused. Its shares still show significant trend strength, ranking in the top 28% of US stocks valued above $1 billion, yet trade about 5% below their 52-week high.

items.title: Where Could Adobe's Next Growth Come From?
items.summary: Adobe’s revenue grew 12% over the last year, slower than most of its big software peers. The share price appears to assume that its growth is fading. Over the last year, the stock fell 35%, while the S&P 500 returned 17.7%. Adobe (ADBE) trades at 12.5 times its earnings, against 22.1 for the index. Management pointed to a small, fast-growing line on its fiscal Q3 2026 call. Is that going to be enough? Where could Adobe’s next real growth come from.

items.summary: Muse for Small Business pushes Meta's AI beyond chat and into everyday business operations, putting it closer to established software providers.

items.title: What Is The Case For Waiting On CRM Stock?
items.summary: Salesforce (CRM) stock has gained about 44% over the past three months, while the S&P 500 rose 3.5%. Investors entering at current levels are buying after a substantial run-up. Consequently, the valuation places greater pressure on upcoming earnings to justify recent gains. Have you already missed the move in Salesforce stock.
